mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 YoY growth > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production signals a weakening economy, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative investor sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO MoM decline > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates a strong demand for new homes, which can lead to increased economic activity and positive spillover effects on related industries, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST > 1.3 million units.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPI) and increasing federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer purchasing power and increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls combined with a low unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when PAYEMS MoM increase > 200k and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS YoY growth > 3%.
